entities.name: George McDuffie
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: George McDuffie was the 55th governor of South Carolina and a member of the United States Senate. Though he began his political career as a partisan of Andrew Jackson, he became one of South Carolina's most outspoken advocates of nullification.
